decision.rationale: I recommend declining this dispute. TXN-008030 (110.12 EUR, MEADOWLARK FUEL, merchant MER-000030) is on card CRD-000248. It posted on 2026-08-11 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-28. That is 78 days, inside the 120-day limit in time-limits. Its authorisation, AUTH-008227, shows entry mode CHIP, PIN verified, response APPROVED and no fraud flag. This means the card and its PIN were both used at the terminal. The card also has several other approved purchases at the same merchant before and after this one: TXN-008028, TXN-007809, TXN-008029, TXN-007800 and TXN-007813. Under unauthorised-chip-and-pin, a chip payment with the PIN verified and no fraud flag counts as made by the cardholder, so the dispute is declined. The cardholder's statement that the card stayed with them does not outweigh the chip and PIN record.

proposed_actions.reason: The payment of 110.12 EUR to MEADOWLARK FUEL on 2026-08-10 was made with your card's chip, and your PIN was entered correctly. Your card has also been used at this merchant several times before and after this date. Under our policy, a chip payment with a correct PIN counts as made by the cardholder, so we cannot treat it as unauthorised.
